questiontext.text:
It is [[if test="is(d0=0)"]]Monday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=1)"]]Tuesday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=2)"]]Wednesday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=3)"]]Thursday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=4)"]]Friday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=5)"]]Saturday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=6)"]]Sunday[[/if]] \([[if test="is(floor(mod(t0,1440)/60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@floor(mod(t0,1440)/60)@}:[[if test="is(mod(mod(t0,1440),60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@mod(mod(t0,1440),60)@}\) local time in Nairobi (take Nairobi to be on \(37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}\)). Take [[if test="is(ix=1)"]]Honolulu[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]Auckland[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]Los Angeles[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]Suva[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]Lima[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]Tokyo[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]Mexico City[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]Wellington[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]Anchorage[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]Brisbane[[/if]] to be on \([[if test="is(ix=1)"]]158^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]175^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]118^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]178^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]77^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]140^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]99^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]175^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]150^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]153^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]]\). What are the day and the local time in [[if test="is(ix=1)"]]Honolulu[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]Auckland[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]Los Angeles[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]Suva[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]Lima[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]Tokyo[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]Mexico City[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]Wellington[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]Anchorage[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]Brisbane[[/if]]?

generalfeedback.text: The difference in longitude is \({@abs(dl)@}^\circ\), so the time difference is \({@abs(dl)@} \times 4 = {@4*abs(dl)@}\) min \(= {@floor(4*abs(dl)/60)@}\) h \({@mod(4*abs(dl),60)@}\) min. [[if test="is(ix=1)"]]Honolulu[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]Auckland[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]Los Angeles[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]Suva[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]Lima[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]Tokyo[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]Mexico City[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]Wellington[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]Anchorage[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]Brisbane[[/if]] is [[if test="east"]]east of Nairobi, so its time is ahead[[else]]west of Nairobi, so its time is behind[[/if]]. Counting [[if test="east"]]on[[else]]back[[/if]] from [[if test="is(d0=0)"]]Monday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=1)"]]Tuesday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=2)"]]Wednesday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=3)"]]Thursday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=4)"]]Friday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=5)"]]Saturday[[/if]][[if test="is(d0=6)"]]Sunday[[/if]] \([[if test="is(floor(mod(t0,1440)/60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@floor(mod(t0,1440)/60)@}:[[if test="is(mod(mod(t0,1440),60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@mod(mod(t0,1440),60)@}\) gives [[if test="chg"]]a time on the [[if test="east"]]next[[else]]previous[[/if]] day: [[/if]][[if test="is(day=0)"]]Monday[[/if]][[if test="is(day=1)"]]Tuesday[[/if]][[if test="is(day=2)"]]Wednesday[[/if]][[if test="is(day=3)"]]Thursday[[/if]][[if test="is(day=4)"]]Friday[[/if]][[if test="is(day=5)"]]Saturday[[/if]][[if test="is(day=6)"]]Sunday[[/if]] \([[if test="is(floor(mod(tm,1440)/60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@floor(mod(tm,1440)/60)@}:[[if test="is(mod(mod(tm,1440),60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@mod(mod(tm,1440),60)@}\).

questiondescription.text:
Navigation: day and time across the world

Grade 12 CBE Core 2.7 (d) / Essential 2.3 (c): Find the day and local time at a place far east or west of Nairobi, including a change of day.

Core and Essential

This question is original to this project.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core and Essential Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).

truefeedback.text: The time is right, but hours run from 0 to 23 and minutes from 0 to 59 on the 24-hour clock.

[[if test="is(ix=1)"]]Honolulu[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]Auckland[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]Los Angeles[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]Suva[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]Lima[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]Tokyo[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]Mexico City[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]Wellington[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]Anchorage[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]Brisbane[[/if]] is [[if test="east"]]east of Nairobi, so its local time is ahead: add[[else]]west of Nairobi, so its local time is behind: subtract[[/if]] \({@4*abs(dl)@}\) minutes.
\(15^\circ\) make one hour, so \(1^\circ\) makes \(4\) minutes, not \(15\) minutes.

falsefeedback.text: [[if test="is(yd=0)"]]Your clock time is the same as the time in Nairobi. Places on different meridians have different local times.[[else]]Your clock time is \({@yd@}\) minutes after \([[if test="is(floor(mod(t0,1440)/60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@floor(mod(t0,1440)/60)@}:[[if test="is(mod(mod(t0,1440),60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@mod(mod(t0,1440),60)@}\) in Nairobi, or \({@1440-yd@}\) minutes before it. Divide by \(4\) to see how many degrees east or west of Nairobi that would be, and compare with the longitude of [[if test="is(ix=1)"]]Honolulu[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]Auckland[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]Los Angeles[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]Suva[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]Lima[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]Tokyo[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]Mexico City[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]Wellington[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]Anchorage[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]Brisbane[[/if]].[[/if]] East is ahead, west is behind; go past midnight if you need to.
